newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in featureless trade, dealers said on Tuesday.
They said most traders were sidelined ahead of tonight's release of the U.S. August consumer confidence index, which is forecast to ease to 104.4 percent compared with 107.2 percent reported in July.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning mainly due to the absence of fresh incentives. Some people are waiting for possible direction from tonight's release of the consumer confidence index for August," a local dealer said.
"But I don't think there will be much impact here unless the numbers are way off market expections," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Tuesday/Wednesday and Wednesday/Thursday were unchanged from Monday's common 5-1/4 5-1/8 percent, respectively. Week-fixed eased 1/16 percentage point to 5-5/16 5-3/16 percent.
Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged at 5-7/16 5-5/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-1/2 5-3/8, six-months unchanged at 5-11/16 5-9/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 5-7/8 5-3/4 percent.
